newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CEZ share surge speculative-dealers.
newsitem.headline: Czech CEZ share surge speculative-dealers.

text.p: Shares in Czech power utility CEZ a.s. surged on a wave of speculative buying on the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) on Wednesday but dealers said fundamentals dido not justify the issue's current price.
CEZ was up 53 crowns, 2.9 percent, to 1,153 just after mid-session during continuous trading on the PSE, putting the issue 17.8 percent higher than at the beginning of this year.
"Fundamentally, I think the price is too high so I would expect some correction. I was a little bit sceptical about breaking through 1,100," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
"There was some speculation that some new money was coming into the market...it might have been the reason (for CEZ's rise)," he added.
CEZ has long lagged behind other Czech blue chips such as SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka mainly because of strict government controls on energy prices.

The issue is widely seen as a cheap way to invest in major Czech issues. CEZ accounts for 13.5 percent of the PX50 index's total capitalisation, making it the second most heavily weighted share behind SPT Telecom.
